# anthropic_analytics_artifacts (Data Source)

Artifact-creation activity for one day, broken out by MIME type and share state, for a Claude Enterprise organization. Data is available from 2026-01-01 with about a one-day lag; the API allows 60 requests per minute per organization. Requires `analytics_api_key` (or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying `read:analytics`).

~> This is a point-in-time report that is re-read on every plan. Use it for outputs and policy checks, not to manage infrastructure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Artifacts created on one day, by MIME type and share state.
data "anthropic_analytics_artifacts" "day" {
  date    = "2026-01-15"
  filters = ["is_shared:true"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `date` (String) UTC day, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

### Optional

- `filters` (List of String) Filters as `dimension:value`; repeat a dimension for OR, mix dimensions for AND. Dimensions: `artifact_type`, `is_shared`, `product`, `rbac_group_id`, `user_id`.
- `group_by` (List of String) Dimensions to break rows out by: `product`, `rbac_group_id`, `user_id`.
- `limit_rows` (Number) Maximum number of rows to keep after reading every page. Unlimited when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `rows` (Attributes List) One row per (artifact_type, is_shared) bucket, times group dimensions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rows))

<a id="nestedatt--rows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rows`

Read-Only:

- `artifact_type` (String) Canonical artifact MIME type, or `other`.
- `artifacts_created_count` (Number) Artifacts created.
- `distinct_user_count` (Number) Distinct creators.
- `is_shared` (Boolean) Whether the artifacts in this bucket have ever been shared.
- `product` (String) Product surface; present only when grouped by `product`.
- `published_artifacts_created_count` (Number) Artifacts published to anyone with the link.
- `rbac_group_id` (String) RBAC group id; present only when grouped by `rbac_group_id`.
- `rbac_group_name` (String) RBAC group name; null when the group was deleted or unresolved.
- `user_id` (String) User id; present only when grouped by `user_id`.
